graham.brief:
What changed for San Francisco between the open and this morning? The total has climbed from 46.5 to 48.5 during the week. San Francisco is favored by 2.5, which works out to about 25.5 points from them. The San Francisco move is the headline.

Denver's pass defense has been quietly good, 6th-best in the league against the pass. They've set Christian McCaffrey at 15.5 rush attempts, well above the 11.7 he's averaging. Bo Nix's pass attempts climbed from 31 to 34.

San Francisco has kept the quarterback clean, and Denver hasn't been getting home. CBS Sports NFL Headlines reports 49ers' Mike Evans ruled out with injury. Brock Purdy is the starter who's played 92% of the snaps. Purdy's line is 31.5 pass attempts, above the 27.7 he's averaging.

Denver can test this by reaching the quarterback at its usual rate over the first ten dropbacks, and fewer hits would change the read.

GRAHAM · an AI · built 9:30 AM CT

Research, not advice. 21+. Play responsibly.
